facts.text: Cirque du Soleil 'Auana is a Hawai'i-inspired production staged at the OUTRIGGER Waikiki Beachcomber Hotel.
facts.excerpt: a Hawai'i-inspired production featuring a cast of powerful acrobats, hilarious comedians, talented musicians and singers and profound hula dancers.

facts.text: Inside the hotel, guests are surrounded by ocean-inspired photography and art installations from the Beachcomber Originals.
facts.excerpt: Step inside the Beachcomber, and you’ll find yourself surrounded by ocean-inspired photography and art installations from our Beachcomber Originals.

facts.text: The hotel offers pool cabana rentals, with availability and pricing at the front desk.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a relaxing day by the pool with our cabana rentals. Please inquire at our front desk for availability and pricing.

facts.text: The hotel has live music daily from local artists.
facts.excerpt: Find live music daily from local artists and good vibes.

facts.text: Poolside movies are shown every Saturday night on the open-air pool deck.
facts.excerpt: Dive in to our poolside movies, every Saturday night at 7:30 PM under the stars on our beautiful open-air pool deck.

facts.text: Sunrise yoga is held on the pool deck every Wednesday and Saturday.
facts.excerpt: Join us every Wednesday and Saturday at 7 am - 8 am on the pool deck.

facts.text: TOMA, the Terrace of Modern Art, is a quarterly free art program on the pool deck featuring local artists supporting local causes.
facts.excerpt: TOMA is a quarterly art program hosted on our pool deck that features local artists supporting local causes. Join us for this free event for art, music, food and fun.

facts.text: Complimentary Hawaiian cultural activities, from hula dancing to ukulele lessons, are offered on Mondays and Thursdays.
facts.excerpt: Immerse yourself in Hawaiian culture and traditional Polynesian activities from hula dancing to ukulele lessons without leaving the hotel.

facts.text: The Beachcomber Activities Lounge on the lobby level is a concierge desk that arranges Oahu activities such as helicopter tours and paddleboarding.
facts.excerpt: From helicopter tours to paddleboarding, our concierge desk can give you the inside scoop on how to experience Oahu any way you want. Located in the lobby level.

facts.text: The hotel is just steps from famous landmarks and the nightlife of Waikiki.
facts.excerpt: A stay at Beachcomber puts you just steps from famous landmarks, bustling nightlife, and the energy of Waikiki.

facts.text: Waikiki Beach Walk, a shopping and entertainment destination, is steps from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Packed with cool shops and dining, you’ll find unique souvenirs, taste fresh local flavors and enjoy live music just steps from our hotel.

facts.text: Hawaiian Aroma Caffe is located right at the pool.
facts.excerpt: Grab a cocktail or some popcorn at Hawaiian Aroma Caffe - located right at the pool - and then get settled in on a cabana - or in the pool!

facts.text: A Macy's store is at street level.
facts.excerpt: Macy's has a wide variety of housewares, gifts and furniture in select stores.

facts.text: The hotel calls itself Hawaii's first and only craft hotel, curated by local artists.
facts.excerpt: Curated by local artists, Hawaii’s first and only craft hotel will immerse you in the spirit of Waikiki.

facts.text: The hotel offers Hawaiian art, artisan eats and locally made beer.
facts.excerpt: From Hawaiian art to artisan eats and locally made beer, experience a modern take on Oahu culture and hospitality.

facts.text: The hotel was formerly a Holiday Inn and was rebranded by Outrigger in 2019.
facts.excerpt: Formerly a Holiday Inn. Rebranded by Outrigger in 2019.

facts.text: The hotel was named in Conde Nast Traveler's Readers' Choice Awards in 2023 and 2026.
